goal: the scenario «Тьма под холмом» (The Darkness Beneath the Hill) from «Двери во тьму» playable from the base (Р-211, item 1 of the queue).
extra:
## This work (Р-213) One scenario of the collection «Двери во тьму» (official Russian edition, `dveri-vo-tmu-ru`) — «Тьма под холмом» by Christopher Smith Adair. **The Russian PDF has no text layer** (a scan): read its pages by OCR — `pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png ` then `tesseract - -l rus` — and check every number on the page image. The English original is registered as `doors-to-darkness-en` (text layer; the scenario is EN pp. 14–34, handouts pp. 111–125, pre-generated characters pp. 126+; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show doors-to-darkness-en

`): use it to find the RU pages (same layout, check the printed page numbers), to check numbers and to fill English names (`name.en`). The owner has an OCR text of the Russian scenario in `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\2_Обработка\1920 Тьма под холмом (Двери во тьму)\` (`…_текст.html`, `…_текст.docx`) — a helper for reading, not a source of its own; the source is the official book (page numbers of `dveri-vo-tmu-ru`). Register the printed/physical page relation of `dveri-vo-tmu-ru` in your coverage file (and tell the lead the offset). - Russian text: as printed in the official edition (it is official — no `translated` flag for text taken from it; names and terms as in the Russian book). Handouts — the official Russian handouts in `…\Двери во тьму (Doors to Darkness)\Раздатка\` (scans; OCR) or the book's collected handouts. - Records — book-scoped `dveri-vo-tmu-ru//` in `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru//`, slugs with the prefix `darkness-`: scenario `darkness-beneath-the-hill` (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; the pre-generated investigators already exist — `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-pregens-ru/` (grep), link them as the scenario's pregens), creatures (known Mythos creatures — `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. The city (Providence or wherever the scenario is set) — a shared city record `coc:location:` (`kb/locations/`; create it if missing, Р-190), the scenario's places as book records `part_of` it, places outside it under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209). Maps — `map` records with the image (`app/maps/dveri-.jpg`, `width`/`height`) and spots on every printed number (Р-206: check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions (`keeper_hint`) — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). - `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35); RU vs EN differences in numbers — `quality.notes` (the Russian edition is the text, the English the check). - Coverage: `checks/20261112-doors-darkness-hill/darkness.md` — every heading of the scenario → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
